scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:apply: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma db seed
scripts.db:status: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma migrate status
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec api pnpm prisma studio --browser none --port 5555
scripts.setup:dev: docker compose up -d --build && docker compose exec api pnpm prisma migrate deploy && docker compose exec api pnpm prisma generate
